name: Python
description: An interpreted, high-level, general-purpose programming language known for its readability and versatility. Dominant in Data Science, AI, and scripting.

name: C#
description: A general-purpose, object-oriented language developed by Microsoft. Used for backend development (APIs, desktop apps) and game development with Unity.

name: JavaScript
description: The core language of the web. Enables interactive frontend development and can be used on the server (Node.js). Supports both OOP and functional paradigms.

name: HTML
description: HyperText Markup Language. The standard for creating web pages and structuring content (text, images, links) in browsers.

name: CSS
description: Cascading Style Sheets. Controls the visual presentation (layout, colors, fonts) of HTML elements on web pages.

name: R
description: A language for statistical computing and graphics. Popular in academia and data analysis for its robust visualization libraries.
